svg.aria-label: The tree in the shared memory of block 0. The 8 cells start as 2, 6, 3, 4, 5, 1, 8, 3. In step with stride = 4, threads 0 to 3 each add 2 cells, its own cell and cell threadIdx.x + 4, into its own cell, giving 2 + 5 = 7, 6 + 1 = 7, 3 + 8 = 11 and 4 + 3 = 7. In step with stride = 2, threads 0 and 1 give 7 + 11 = 18 and 7 + 7 = 14. In step with stride = 1, thread 0 gives 18 + 14 = 32. Two arrows lead into every new value, and a barrier separates the steps.
svg.text: A tree sum in shared memory
Each step adds 2 cells into 1; a barrier separates the steps.

g.text: cells 0 to 7 in the shared memory of block 0
Each new value is the sum of 2 cells: its own cell and the cell stride places to the right.
Gray cells are no longer read. After step with stride = 1, cell 0 holds 32.
